integrity: The proof classifies minimal forts from the defining outside-neighborhood condition, identifies the fort hypergraph with a disjoint union of two complete graphs, and then derives the matching, fractional-transversal, and transversal parameters. A standalone checker independently enumerates forts, simulates zero forcing, and solves the original LP.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to double stars with at least two leaves at each center.
Uses the fort-cover LP definition of fractional zero forcing, not the earlier three-color forcing parameter.
Finite exhaustive and LP verification over 2 <= a,b <= 6 is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently named or non-indexed double-star treatment.
title: Fort hypergraph and fractional zero forcing of double stars
